rule Trojan_GenericKD_48571234_Memory_Injection {
    meta:
        description = "Detects in-memory code injection patterns associated with Trojan.GenericKD.48571234"
        author = "SOC Team"
        malware = "Trojan.GenericKD.48571234"
        attack = "T1055 - Process Injection"
    strings:
        $x1 = { 6A 00 68 [2] 00 00 64 A1 00 00 00 00 6A 00 68 [4] 6A 00 E8 [4] 83 C4 14 } // Common shellcode stub
        $x2 = "CryptEncrypt" fullword ascii
        $x3 = "VirtualAllocEx" fullword ascii
        $x4 = "WriteProcessMemory" fullword ascii
    condition:
        any of ($x*) and (uint32(@x1 + 2) == 0x00000000 or uint32(@x1 + 7) == 0x00000000)
}
